literal: kings - things desired - not desiring - by kings - enduring - wealth - will give
translation: Not coveting the things that kings desire will yield enduring wealth through those very kings.
modern: அரசர்கள் விரும்பும் பொருள்களைத் தான் விரும்பாமல் இருப்பது, அந்த அரசர்களாலேயே ஒருவனுக்கு நிலைபெற்ற செல்வத்தைப் பெற்றுத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet advises those who serve or associate with rulers on how to secure lasting prosperity. The phrase 'மன்னர் விழைப' refers to the objects, pleasures, or ambitions that the king himself desires. 'விழையாமை' means refraining from coveting those same things, as competing with a ruler leads to their displeasure and one's own ruin. By avoiding such rivalry, an associate earns the ruler's trust, which 'தரும்' (will yield) 'மன்னிய ஆக்கம்' (enduring wealth) directly 'மன்னரால்' (through the king).
